AI Notes.value: Alex Prager (b. 1979, Los Angeles; lives and works in LA) is a self-taught photographer, filmmaker, and gallery artist operating at the top of her field. She runs Alex Prager Studio LLC independently, is represented by Lehmann Maupin (NY, London, Seoul), and has exhibited at MoMA, LACMA, Corcoran, and NGV among others. Career trajectory: began photography ~2007, transitioned into short films 2008-2010, Emmy Award 2012 (News and Documentary) for Touch of Evil, Foam Paul Huf Award 2012, solo major gallery shows from 2013 onward, debut feature film DreamQuil premiered at SXSW March 2026 (stars Elizabeth Banks and John C. Reilly). Approximately 19 years of practice. Fully autonomous (5): sets her own creative agenda across photography, fine art film, and public performance.
